name: Bubble Loss for Thin Object Recovery
definition: A loss term applied to 'bubbles' (3D points derived from depth images) to enforce zero SDF values, recovering gradients for thin/small objects where standard SDF training fails due to vanishing gradients.
summary: Bubble Loss recovers thin objects in SDFs by targeting depth-derived points to enforce zero values, bypassing vanishing gradients that cause standard training to ignore small structures.
